name: design
description: Design, build, and review product interfaces with grounded context and research.

interface.longDescription: Create distinctive web and native interfaces, refine existing products, recreate visual references, and review real workflows. Keep product context and design-system sources organized. Turn user research into evidence-backed decisions. Includes complete workflows for critique, accessibility, UX copy, design systems, research, and developer handoff.
defaultPrompt: Use $design to design and build this interface.
Use $design-review to audit this product flow.
Use $design-context to organize this product’s design sources.
